identificationModule.briefTitle: JAB-23E73 in Adult Participants With Advanced Solid Tumors With KRAS Alteration
identificationModule.officialTitle: A Phase 1/2a, Multicenter, Open-label Study to Evaluate the Safety, Tolerability, Pharmacokinetics, and Preliminary Anti-tumor Activity of JAB-23E73 Monotherapy and in Combination With Other Agents in Adult Patients With Advanced Solid Tumors With KRAS Alteration

descriptionModule.briefSummary: This study is to evaluate the safety and tolerability of pan-KRAS inhibitor JAB-23E73 Monotherapy and in Combination with Other Agents in adult participants with advanced solid tumors
descriptionModule.detailedDescription:
This is a multi-part, open-label, multi-center Phase 1/2a study evaluating JAB-23E73 as monotherapy (Part A) and in combination with other agents (Part B1: with cetuximab) in adult participants with advanced solid tumors.

Part A will evaluate the safety, tolerability, pharmacokinetics, pharmacodynamics, and preliminary anticancer activity of JAB-23E73 as a single agent in adult patients with advanced solid tumors with KRAS alteration. Part A consists of three phases: Phase 1a dose-escalation, Phase 1b dose expansion (dose optimization), and Phase 2a indication expansion.

Part B1 will evaluate the safety, tolerability, PK, PDc, and preliminary anti-tumor efficacy of JAB-23E73 combined with cetuximab in adult participants with locally advanced or metastatic KRAS-altered CRC. Part B1 consists of two phases: Phase 1b dose escalation phase and Phase 2a dose expansion phase.

keywords: KRAS G12C, KRAS G12D, KRAS G12V, KRAS G12S, KRAS G12A, KRAS G12D

primaryOutcomes.measure: Part A: Number and proportion of patients who experience at least 1 dose-limiting toxicity (DLT) with treatment of JAB-23E73 monotherapy.
primaryOutcomes.description: A DLT is defined as any toxicities that meet the criteria for a DLT defined in the protocol

primaryOutcomes.measure: Part A: Safety and tolerability of JAB-23E73 monotherapy
primaryOutcomes.description: Incidence, and severity of adverse events and changes in clinical laboratory tests and examinations.

primaryOutcomes.measure: Part A: Objective response rate (ORR) of JAB-23E73 monotherapy.
primaryOutcomes.description: ORR, defined as the percentage of patients with the best overall response of confirmed partial response (PR), or complete response (CR) per RECIST v1.1.

primaryOutcomes.measure: Part B1: Safety, tolerability and RP2D of JAB-23E73 in combination with cetuximab.
primaryOutcomes.description: Incidence, and severity of adverse events and changes in clinical laboratory tests and examinations. RP2D will be determined based on comprehensive available data

primaryOutcomes.measure: Part B1: Objective response rate (ORR) of JAB-23E73 in combination with cetuximab.
primaryOutcomes.description: ORR, defined as the percentage of patients with the best overall response of confirmed PR, or CR per RECIST v1.1.

secondaryOutcomes.measure: Part A: DOR, TTR, PFS, and DCR assessed by investigators, and OS of JAB-23E73 monotherapy
secondaryOutcomes.description: Assessed according to Response Evaluation Criteria in Solid Tumors (RECIST) v1.1.

secondaryOutcomes.measure: Part A: Pharmacokinetic (PK) profile of JAB-23E73 monotherapy
secondaryOutcomes.description: Maximum Observed Concentration (Cmax), time to reach maximum concentration (Tmax), and area under the plasma concentration-time curve (AUC), etc

secondaryOutcomes.measure: Part B1: DOR, TTR, PFS, and DCR assessed by investigators, and OS of JAB-23E73 in combination with cetuximab
secondaryOutcomes.description: Assessed according to Response Evaluation Criteria in Solid Tumors (RECIST) v1.1.

secondaryOutcomes.measure: Part B1: PK profile of JAB-23E73 in combination with cetuximab.
secondaryOutcomes.description: The plasma concentration and PK parameters of JAB-23E73, including but not limited to: Cmax, AUC, and Ctrough.

eligibilityModule.eligibilityCriteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Written informed consent.
* Participant must be ≥18 years of age at the time of signing the Informed Consent Form (ICF).
* Histologically or cytologically confirmed locally advanced or metastatic solid tumors that are not suitable for curative interventions and who have received relevant prior systemic therapy.(Part A)
* Histologically/cytologically confirmed unresectable locally advanced or metastatic CRC who progressed on or were intolerant to ≥1 standard systemic regimen with fluorouracil derivatives, oxaliplatin, irinotecan, FDA-approved immunotherapy or targeted therapies.(Part B1 only)
* Patients must have KRAS alterations.
* Participants are required to provide an archived tumor sample.
* Patients with a life expectancy ≥3 months.
* ECOG performance status score of 0 or 1.
* Patients must have at least one measurable lesion as defined by RECIST v1.1.

Exclusion Criteria:

* Inability to swallow oral medications, or presence of gastrointestinal dysfunction or gastrointestinal disorders that may significantly alter the absorption of the study drug.
* Patients who have previously been treated with KRAS G12C inhibitors, KRAS G12D inhibitors, pan-RAS/pan-KRAS/multi-KRAS inhibitors, or similar agents.
* Participants who have previously been treated with cetuximab or other EGFR antibodies (Part B1 only).
* Known serious allergy to JAB-23E73 or excipient.
* Patients with primary central nervous system tumors.
* Uncontrolled pleural effusion, pericardial effusion, or ascites requiring recurrent drainage procedures or medical intervention.
* QT interval\>470 msec.
* LVEF ≤50% assessed by ECHO or MUGA.
